transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... well, I guess I'm here because of my face. We put a brighter mirror in our bathroom recently, and... I just keep noticing my skin. Mostly around my cheeks and my jaw. It just looks really uneven to me. Or kind of saggy. 

My husband says he can't really see what I'm talking about, but... yeah. That's why I came in.
Do you spend more than an hour a day thinking about your skin?

I don't really time it. But... like I said, ever since we put that brighter mirror in, I just keep noticing the sagging and the unevenness. So... I guess it's on my mind a fair amount. Even if my husband doesn't see what I'm talking about.
Is thinking about your skin causing you a lot of distress?
I don't know if I'd call it... distress. It's just something I notice. It's bothersome, I guess. But I wouldn't say it's a lot of distress.
Is thinking about your skin affecting your daily activities?

I mean... I still get my work done. It's not like that. It just... takes me a little longer to get ready now. So I guess I've had to rush into the courthouse a few mornings. And... I've missed the start of my yoga class a couple times because of it. 

And, I don't know, I guess I've stepped out of a few casual photos lately. Like at my book club and some community events. I just... didn't want to worry about how my face would look in them. But I'm still doing everything I normally do.
Do you think your skin actually looks uneven and saggy, or is it just something that bothers you when you look in the mirror?
I'm not really sure what you mean. I... I see it when I look in the mirror. So I guess I think it actually looks that way. I don't really know.
Do you think others can see the unevenness and sagging in your skin when they look at you?

I... I don't know. My husband says he can't really see what I'm talking about. But we put in a brighter bathroom mirror recently, and... ever since then, I just keep noticing it around my cheeks and jaw. So I'm not sure what other people see.
Do you think that your view of your skin is possibly exaggerated or not entirely accurate?
I don't know... I mean, I see what I see. I guess it's possible I focus on it more than other people do, but... it's definitely there.
Is there something specific about the unevenness or sagging that bothers you, like a particular line or spot?
I don't know... it's just... the whole area around my cheeks and jaw. I can't really point to one specific spot. It's just the way it all looks together.
Do you think that someone who didn't know you would notice the unevenness and sagging in your skin if they saw you in person?

I... I really couldn't say. Like I mentioned, my husband tells me he doesn't see what I'm talking about, so... maybe a stranger wouldn't either. But ever since we put in that brighter mirror, I just keep noticing how saggy and uneven my cheeks and jaw look. So... I don't know. I just know what it looks like to me.
Is your concern about your skin mostly about how it looks in general or is it focused on this specific unevenness and sagging you mentioned?

I guess... it's just that specific thing. Like I said, ever since we got that brighter mirror in the bathroom, I just... I keep seeing that the skin there, around my cheeks and jaw, is uneven. And saggy. Even if my husband doesn't see it. That's... that's really all it is.
Do you think that your skin would look uneven and saggy to a dermatologist or a plastic surgeon if they examined you?

I suppose... they might. I mean, they're professionals, so they know what to look for. But... like I said, I just know that since we changed that mirror, I keep seeing it. The unevenness and the sagging around my jaw. Even if my husband doesn't... I just see it.
Do you think that your skin would look perfectly normal if you didn't look in the mirror?

I... I don't know. Maybe. I just know that... well, I'm here because of what I see when I do look. Ever since we put in that brighter mirror, I just keep noticing it. The unevenness. The sagging. Even if my husband says he can't see it... I do. So, I don't know what it would look like if I didn't look. I just know what I see when I do.
Do you think that your perception of your skin's unevenness and sagging might be different from how it actually looks?
I don't know. I mean... I see what I see. I don't really know how to answer that.
Is your concern about your skin focused on this one issue of unevenness and sagging, or do you also worry about other aspects of your appearance?
No. Um... not really. It's mostly just... just what I mentioned. The sagging. I don't really focus on anything else.
Do you think your skin would look uneven and saggy to someone who didn't know you and had no reason to be polite about it?

I... I don't really know. Like I said, my husband claims he can't see what I'm talking about. So maybe a stranger wouldn't either. But... I just know that in that bright bathroom mirror, the skin right around my cheeks and my jaw... it just looks saggy to me. I can't really speak for what someone else would see.
Do you think your skin looks uneven and saggy even when you're not looking in a mirror?
Um... I'm not really sure. I guess I just... I know it's there. But I don't really know how it looks if I'm not actually looking at it. I haven't really thought about it like that.
Do you think your skin would look perfectly fine to everyone else, even if you didn't tell them about the unevenness and sagging you see?

I mean... probably? Like I said, my husband says he can't really see what I'm talking about. So maybe other people think it's fine. It's just... ever since we put in that brighter bathroom mirror, I just keep noticing it. To me, the skin around my cheeks and jaw just looks uneven and kind of saggy. I don't really know what anyone else thinks.
Do you think your skin looks uneven and saggy even when others tell you it doesn't?

Yeah... I mean, like I was just saying... my husband tells me he doesn't see what I'm talking about. But... I still see it. 

Ever since we put that brighter mirror in the bathroom, I just... I keep noticing the skin around my jaw and cheeks. So, yes... even if he says it's fine, it still looks uneven and kind of saggy to me.
Do you think your skin looks uneven and saggy even if a doctor told you it was perfectly normal?
I guess... I don't really know. I haven't asked a doctor about it before. So... I'm not sure what I would think.
